newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Property developer takes option on Q.Charl.
newsitem.headline: Property developer takes option on Q.Charl.

text.p: New Zealand holding company Queen Charlotte Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its majority shareholder Oregon Forestry NZ Ltd had given a call option over its 53 percent stake in the company to a vehicle associated with leisure and property developer Ken Wikeley.

"The put option held by current Queen Charlotte shareholders will not be affected by this transaction or any subsequent sale of shareholding," the company said in a statement to the New Zealand Stock Exchange.

It did not expand on what plans, if any, Wikeley had for the company if he took up the option, but said "when the directors receive proposals relating to the future direction of the company such proposals will be properly evaluated and then submitted to the shareholders for approval."
Queen Charlotte, formerly Regal Salmon Ltd, sold its business assets last year.
